turns.q: Does the cheaper one have the same warranty as the pricier one?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out to us 😊 Yes, the cheaper piece has the same standard 30-day warranty for manufacturing defects as the pricier one. The price does not change the standard coverage.

A 1 Year EVRY Protection Plan is separate and only applies if it was added at checkout for $2.99 USD. It provides the extended coverage and package protection for that item 💖
